title: IdeaSeek TopicSynthesis (topic-synthesis-v1)
description: Structural contract for a topic cluster synthesis, a sound subset of validateTopicSynthesis (src/knowledge/synthesis.ts). `required` holds only the keys the prompt asks the model for AND that survive into the artifact: topicId, inputHash, papers, generator and generatedAt are stamped by the worker (src/worker/synthesis-handlers.ts) and never sent by the model, so they are typed here but not required — one file then validates the raw harness answer and the persisted knowledge/topic-synthesis alike. Whether a cited source really is one of the cluster's papers, verbatim-quote checking and what inputHash keys (the incremental cache) stay in TypeScript.

keyFindings.description: text+source are enforced by validateTopicSynthesis; page/quote are declared nullable by the prompt and checked by nothing, so they may also be absent (renderTopicSynthesis skips them).

mechanisms.description: May be honestly empty; the prompt's WHY/WHEN-it-fails rule is judgement and is not encoded.

papers.description: Cluster membership, rebuilt wholesale by the writer from the cluster, so a model-supplied value is never trusted; may legitimately be absent in the raw answer.
